newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE grains lower as stg shrugs off AM wobble.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE grains lower as stg shrugs off AM wobble.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended a choppy day lower, mirroring sterling's progress.
The initial post-election weakness of the UK currency sent prices up, but its later recovery brought wheat down again, traders said.
November was most active, with 214 lots done of a total 607. It last traded 0.75 stg lower at 96.75 stg.

New crop remained under the influence of the weather, amid sentiment that predicted weekend rain would not be enough to solve the problems created by a long dry spell. "Once the rain's out of the way, it isn't going to look much better," one trader said.
On the old crop, the currency inspired weakness was magnified by ample supplies. "There's far too much old crop around," the trader said.
July last traded 1.15 stg lower at 95.00 stg in a volume of 198 lots, having seen its contract low of 94.25 stg earlier in the day.
November was most active of the contracts on barley, with 11 of a total 14 lots. It last traded 0.25 stg lower at 92.75 stg.
The market is closed on Monday, May 5 for a holiday. It reopens on Tuesday, May 6.
